equity.Bullish: Equity market optimism: stock prices rising, benchmark index gains, market rally, positive corporate growth, expansion.
equity.Bearish: Equity market pessimism: stock prices falling, benchmark index drops, market selloff, decline, warnings, downward pressure.

fixed_income.Bullish: Fixed income optimism: bond yields climbing, bond prices rising due to strong demand, positive auction results, safe-haven inflows.
fixed_income.Bearish: Fixed income pessimism: bond market selloff, yields plunging unexpectedly, weak auction demand, sovereign debt concerns, capital flight.

volatility.Bullish: Volatility increase: fear gauges rising, market panic, VIX surging, massive uncertainty.
volatility.Bearish: Volatility decrease: market calm, VIX dropping, complacency, low volatility.

currency.Bullish: Currency strength: appreciation, rising exchange rate, strong demand, favorable interest rate differentials.
currency.Bearish: Currency weakness: depreciation, falling exchange rate, capital outflows, dovish monetary policy.

commodity.Bullish: Commodity price rise: supply shortages, high demand, price rally, positive macroeconomic trends.
commodity.Bearish: Commodity price fall: oversupply, weak demand, price drop, economic slowdown.
